title: confidence.json: the Release Confidence Score (contract 1.9.0, not stable)
description: Since 1.9.0. Written by `harness confidence` beside the run it scores, and by `harness release` in out/<timestamp>-release-command/. The Gate first, then the RCS (only when the Gate is PASS or WARN) and its band, then eight dimensions, each with every point lost and its evidence. Advisory: never an input to the gate, a verdict or an exit code. Derived from Confidence in src/score/confidence.ts. Not stable: it may change in a minor release.

why.description: What was read and why it cost points: names the hunk, claim, PR, file or run.

evidence.description: Where to look: a link relative to confidence.json into a run's report.html (…/report.html#hunk-<id>, #stale-claims, #noise, #masks, #load, #migration, #upgrade), an input file, or a PR.

floor.description: Present when this finding breaches the dimension's floor, which caps the RCS at 74.

weight.description: The nominal weight (src/score/weights.ts); the ones the mean used are in weightsUsed.

score.description: 0-100: 100 minus the deductions; null when not measured (never 100 for a missing input).

reason.description: Why it is not measured, and which input would measure it.

evidence.description: Where this dimension's evidence is: sections of the runs' report.html, or the input files.

gaps.description: Parts of what 100 means that this dimension could not check with what it was given.

gate.description: The Gate, as the gate decided it. Always first.

rcs.description: The Release Confidence Score: the weighted mean of the measured dimensions rounded down, capped at 74 when a floor is breached. null when the Gate is not PASS or WARN.

band.description: Green >= 90, Amber 75-89, Red < 75; null with no RCS.

meaning.description: The band's one-line meaning. Absent with no band.

note.description: Why there is no RCS, or why it was capped.

mean.description: The weighted mean before rounding and the cap, two decimals; null with no RCS.

weightsUsed.description: The weight each measured dimension had in the mean, renormalised to sum to 100. A dimension that is not measured is absent.

glance.description: The reviewer's glance (C3). Empty until it is built.
